Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/adhoc job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/adhoc step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/adhoc/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
